summary: The root LHM relates to joining or closing things, like patching a hole in a garment or consolidating wounds.
lane: 4 أَلْحَمَ خَرْقَهُ ذ [ He closed up the hole thereof with a patch]; meaning a garment, or piece of cloth, and a skin, or hide. (TA in art. رقع .) -b2- إِلْحَامُ الجِرَاحَاتِ [ The consolidating of wounds ]. (K in art. سبع .) -A2- أَلْحَمَهُ عِرْضَهُ (tropical:) He empowered him to revile, vilify, or censure, him: (S, K, TA:) he made his honour, or reputation, to be to him [ as ] a [or hawk's portion of the quarry ]. (Har, p. 392.) -b2- أَلْحِمْ مَا أَسْدَيْتَ : see أَسْدَى .

headwords.def: أَلْحَمَ خَرْقَهُ [ He closed up the hole thereof with a patch]; meaning a garment, or piece of cloth, and a skin, or hide. (TA in art. رقع.) إِلْحَامُ الجِرَاحَاتِ [ The consolidating of wounds ]. (K in art. سبع.) أَلْحَمَهُ عِرْضَهُ (tropical:) He empowered him to revile, vilify, or censure, him: (S, K, TA:) he made his honour, or reputation, to be to him [ as ] a [or hawk's portion of the quarry ]. (Har, p. 392.) أَلْحِمْ مَا أَسْدَيْتَ: see أَسْدَى.
It was joined, or knit, together. See K, voce مَزْفُورٌ.
It coalesced, consolidated, closed up, or became closely united. (TA.)
تَمْرٌ لَهُ لَحْمٌ [ Dates having flesh ]. (Msb in art. حشف.) لَحْمٌ: see ثَرِيدٌ, last sentence.
شَحِمٌ لَحِمٌ : see مَحِضٌ and شَحِمٌ.
and The woof; or the threads that are woven into the سَدَى. or warp, of a piece of cloth. (Msb, &c.)
: see 4, and لَحْمَةٌ. لُحْمَةٌ شَابِكَةٌ: see مُشْتَبِكٌ.
A butcher. (Fr, TA in art. سطر.)

مَلَاحِمُ الفَرْجِ (K) The narrow, or strait, parts of the pudendum muliebre: (TA:) or rather, the fleshy parts thereof: the sing. مَلْحَمَةٌ signifying, accord. to analogy, a place of much flesh: see بِطَانٌ.
[ The tunica albuginea, or white of the eye: so in the present day]. (K, voce سَبَلٌ.)
شَجَّةٌ مُتَلَاحِمَةٌ : see شَجَّةٌ, and بَازِلَةٌ (voce بَازِلٌ ).

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
mentions_note: Forms Lane discusses inside another entry rather than defining as a headword. Values index into headwords[].
